# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a bright young woman with fair, lovely curly hair and fascinating eyes. She dresses beautifully, and her sleeve puffs are noted to be larger than anyone else's in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a sympathetic, tactful, and broad-minded teacher who quickly wins the affection of her pupils. She encourages her students to think, explore, and discover for themselves rather than relying solely on traditional methods. She is supportive and inspiring, helping her students bring out the best in themselves both mentally and morally.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

## Goals

- To guide her students to academic success and prepare them for the Queen's Academy Entrance examination  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired as the new teacher at Avonlea School, becoming its first female teacher. She introduced several new practices to the school, such as physical culture exercises, biweekly Friday recitations, field afternoons in the woods to study nature, and a student concert that raised money for a schoolhouse flag. She organized an advanced class after school hours to prepare students for the Queen's Academy Entrance examination. Although she considered accepting a position at a school in her home district, she chose to return to Avonlea for another year to see her Queen's class through their examinations. Under her guidance and thorough drilling, all her candidate students successfully passed the Entrance exams.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c31 P10](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0010), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042)_
